recipes.symptom: Primary statement loses first glance to a large image or navigation.
recipes.implementation: Reduce decorative size/contrast, elevate the H1 and place supporting action near the proposition.
recipes.acceptance_test: A five-second glance identifies the primary proposition; the DOM reading sequence still makes sense.
failure_modes: Inflating every heading or making secondary actions disappear.

recipes.symptom: Two or more unrelated CTAs look equally primary.
recipes.implementation: Resolve actual user decision; emphasize one task-default and style alternatives as secondary without hiding them.
recipes.acceptance_test: Participants identify primary action; alternate action remains discoverable and operable.
failure_modes: Using color to disguise cancellation or consent choices.

recipes.symptom: Hierarchy collapses without colored accents.
recipes.implementation: Differentiate sizes, weights, spatial grouping and foreground/background tone.
recipes.acceptance_test: Greyscale screenshot preserves at least three meaningful hierarchy levels; all required contrasts pass separately.
failure_modes: Treating grayscale appearance as a substitute for measured contrast.

recipes.symptom: Screens use ad hoc hues without consistent meaning.
recipes.implementation: Inventory colors; define neutral ramp, primary accent, semantic feedback roles and light/dark mappings as tokens.
recipes.acceptance_test: Every new UI color maps to an explicit semantic role and works in every supported theme.
failure_modes: Removing necessary status colors to chase a fixed palette size.

recipes.symptom: Everything calls for attention using saturated accents.
recipes.implementation: Reserve high-chroma accent for primary action/highest hierarchy; use neutral and muted supporting surfaces.
recipes.acceptance_test: Attention test identifies intended focal element without relying solely on hue.
failure_modes: Overusing 60/30/10 as a hard percentage across functional dashboards.

recipes.symptom: Primary/background colors work as swatches but fail in actual text/control states.
recipes.implementation: Build pairing matrix for text, backgrounds, borders, links, focus and status; measure contrast for each rendered state.
recipes.acceptance_test: WCAG 2.1 AA SC 1.4.3 and 1.4.11 evaluated for applicable actual color pairings; status never color-only.
failure_modes: Claiming a palette is WCAG-compliant because one swatch pair passes.

recipes.symptom: Multiple arbitrary heading sizes and inconsistent type weights.
recipes.implementation: Adopt a modest fluid type scale with named roles; test large text and line wrapping before freezing values.
recipes.acceptance_test: All headings map to named roles; layout tolerates 200% zoom and longer strings.
failure_modes: Applying golden-ratio scaling blindly to dense software interfaces.

recipes.symptom: Paragraphs feel compressed or overlong across the viewport.
recipes.implementation: Tune measure (approx. 55–75 characters), line-height, margins and readable body size; adjust by font and task.
recipes.acceptance_test: Reading in narrow and wide screens has no clipped lines or forced horizontal scrolling.
failure_modes: Hard-coding max-width or font values that override user settings.

recipes.symptom: Unrelated font families conflict with the desired aesthetic.
recipes.implementation: Choose one versatile family or purposeful display/body pairing; define fallbacks and license-valid loading.
recipes.acceptance_test: Fonts render consistently under slow network/fallback and in multilingual content.
failure_modes: Assuming serif/sans stereotypes are hard readability facts.

recipes.symptom: Captions, controls and supporting text visually merge.
recipes.implementation: Use proximity: tighten within a group, increase gaps between groups and align major edges.
recipes.acceptance_test: At mobile and desktop widths, related elements are identifiable without outlines.
failure_modes: Increasing whitespace uniformly until comparison tasks require excess scrolling.

recipes.symptom: Desktop layout relies on fragile fixed columns and clipping.
recipes.implementation: Use CSS grid minmax(), min(), auto-fit or container queries; allow content-driven stacking.
recipes.acceptance_test: No lost content, overlap or horizontal scroll at narrow viewports and zoom/reflow.
failure_modes: Treating visual order and DOM/keyboard order as interchangeable.

recipes.symptom: Card labels, titles and actions jump between baselines.
recipes.implementation: Set shared grid tracks and layout tokens; allow variable content while aligning semantically similar landmarks.
recipes.acceptance_test: Across content variants, rows/columns remain visually stable without truncating text.
failure_modes: Forcing fixed heights that clip translations or magnification.

recipes.symptom: A high-saturation photo overwhelms message and action.
recipes.implementation: Reduce media area or saturation, move focal content, add counterweight via spatial grouping.
recipes.acceptance_test: At three responsive widths the hero conveys intended priority and does not collapse.
failure_modes: Assuming equal pixel area creates equal perceived visual weight.

recipes.symptom: Sidebar, image and headline sizes feel arbitrary screen-to-screen.
recipes.implementation: Choose documented ranges for proportions; constrain with min/max not rigid ratios; align to content priority.
recipes.acceptance_test: Test compact and expanded data; sidebar remains useful and content readable.
failure_modes: Enforcing golden ratio as mandatory or more important than task needs.

recipes.symptom: Unintended empty region makes composition look unfinished.
recipes.implementation: Check whether intentional asymmetry supports focal point; if not redistribute density or move supporting elements.
recipes.acceptance_test: Review paired wide/narrow compositions with intended hierarchy stated.
failure_modes: Making every screen symmetric and losing necessary asymmetrical emphasis.

recipes.symptom: Same role buttons/cards/icons have different styling across pages.
recipes.implementation: Consolidate component styles and spacing into semantic tokens; permit role-based variants only.
recipes.acceptance_test: Comparison of three pages reveals consistent role treatments.
failure_modes: Treating meaningful error vs neutral states as style inconsistency.

recipes.symptom: Repeated cards make important content indistinguishable.
recipes.implementation: Preserve component system but vary content weight/featured layout for genuinely different priority.
recipes.acceptance_test: Viewer can find featured item in a short scanning task.
failure_modes: Inventing false priority to create aesthetic variation.

recipes.symptom: Decorative repeating texture competes with labels and task data.
recipes.implementation: Reduce scale/opacity and remove texture behind readable content; avoid visual flicker.
recipes.acceptance_test: Body/controls remain legible and attention goes to content, not motif.
failure_modes: Adding decorative motion as the only grouping cue.

recipes.symptom: User attention stalls on an image rather than the next step.
recipes.implementation: Reorder content blocks and align landmarks; use directional image crops only if they support task flow.
recipes.acceptance_test: Observed scan and task completion reach intended conclusion.
failure_modes: Assuming everyone reads in Z or F patterns.

recipes.symptom: CSS visual rearrangement implies sequence contradictory to keyboard order.
recipes.implementation: Preserve meaningful DOM sequence and use CSS only to reflow, not semantically reorder tasks.
recipes.acceptance_test: Tab and screen-reader sequence agree with visible logical flow.
failure_modes: Using CSS order to mask incorrect semantic markup.

recipes.symptom: Users cannot locate the next step in a long presentation.
recipes.implementation: Introduce clear subheads, grouping, whitespace and step-specific emphasis; avoid ornamental arrows.
recipes.acceptance_test: Task walkthrough can explain what is next at each section.
failure_modes: Hiding needed context behind animated reveal transitions.

recipes.symptom: Components hard-code dozens of shades, gaps, fonts or radii.
recipes.implementation: Define primitive→semantic→component tokens; migrate one component family at a time.
recipes.acceptance_test: Static checks show component values draw from intended tokens; theme change propagates.
failure_modes: Creating a large token framework before evidence of reuse.

recipes.symptom: Same component behaves/looks differently across product areas.
recipes.implementation: Inventory variants; consolidate shared components while preserving semantic differences.
recipes.acceptance_test: Screenshot matrix covers default, hover, focus, active, disabled, error and dark mode.
failure_modes: Changing UX semantics just to achieve visual uniformity.

recipes.symptom: Light/dark theme inversion destroys hierarchy or contrast.
recipes.implementation: Use role-named semantic colors and validate each theme state independently.
recipes.acceptance_test: Contrast/legibility pass on both themes; design identity remains recognizable.
failure_modes: Mechanical color inversion or treating dark mode as optional untested ornament.

recipes.symptom: Logo/icons blur when resized or misalign across pixel densities.
recipes.implementation: Prefer licensed SVG for flat scalable artwork, responsive raster assets for photos; inspect aspect ratio.
recipes.acceptance_test: Icon silhouette stays crisp across DPR and controls retain accessible names.
failure_modes: Using SVG where a bitmap photo is clearly better or using untrusted unsafe SVG markup.

recipes.symptom: Illustrations, photos and icons use incompatible linework, light or color grade.
recipes.implementation: Specify crop, light, saturation, illustration strokes and backgrounds as art-direction rules.
recipes.acceptance_test: Side-by-side media grid reads as a coherent set without reducing essential content variation.
failure_modes: Applying filters that obscure important visual evidence or accuracy.

recipes.symptom: Fine text disappears against busy background images.
recipes.implementation: Add stable text backing/scrim or relocate text; ensure contrast under worst crop and image load failure.
recipes.acceptance_test: Text passes WCAG on representative imagery/crops and remains legible during image loading.
failure_modes: Relying on average photo luminance or a gradient without testing extremes.

recipes.symptom: A pleasing UI mood is inconsistent with product and audience.
recipes.implementation: Record audience/task, 3–5 desired attributes, accepted brand constraints and counterexamples.
recipes.acceptance_test: Stakeholders identify intended qualities using unlabeled screens rather than logo alone.
failure_modes: Universalizing cultural color stereotypes or guessing brand personality.

recipes.symptom: Teams redesign screens without shared visual direction.
recipes.implementation: Curate a small annotated reference set; identify invariant palette/type/image constraints, and unacceptable cues.
recipes.acceptance_test: Prototype selection can be justified against explicit attributes and task outcomes.
failure_modes: Copying proprietary designs or using moodboard imagery without rights.

recipes.symptom: Marketing, product and email look like different services.
recipes.implementation: Connect brand rules to semantic tokens, component patterns and illustration guidance with clear ownership.
recipes.acceptance_test: Blind brand-recognition comparison across surfaces and documented exceptions.
failure_modes: Making function-specific product pages identical to campaign landing pages.
